_popis: Ručně psané věty po skupinách. [správně|špatně|špatně] = mezera s možnostmi (první je správná), pozn = vysvětlení po odpovědi. Skupinu používá generátor vety s param {skupina}. Nová skupina = nový klíč, stačí ji dát do patra v patra.json.

kontext.rada: Signální slovo chybí? Ptej se: děje se to **teď** (Pst!, Podívej!, Kde je…?), nebo **pořád / vždycky** (pravda, povolání, zvyk)?

vety.v: Shh! The baby dragon [is sleeping|sleeps].
vety.pozn: Shh! = buď potichu, protože se to děje **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Water [boils|is boiling] at 100 degrees.
vety.pozn: Platí to vždycky (obecná pravda) → present simple.

vety.v: The sun [rises|is rising] in the east.
vety.pozn: Obecná pravda → present simple.

vety.v: Hurry up! Everybody [is waiting|waits] for you.
vety.pozn: Hurry up! – čekají **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Why [are you laughing|do you laugh]? What's so funny?
vety.pozn: Směje se **právě teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Can you hear that? Polly [is singing|sings] in the shower.
vety.pozn: Slyšíš to? → děje se to teď → present continuous.

vety.v: Penguins [live|are living] in cold places.
vety.pozn: Obecná pravda o tučňácích → present simple.

vety.v: Be careful! Pierre [is carrying|carries] ten cakes.
vety.pozn: Pozor! Nese je **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Cats [sleep|are sleeping] a lot.
vety.pozn: Platí to o kočkách obecně → present simple.

vety.v: Where is Boo? – He [is hiding|hides] under the bed.
vety.pozn: Kde je teď? → present continuous.

vety.v: Bolt is a robot. He [runs|is running] on batteries.
vety.pozn: Jak robot funguje, platí pořád → present simple.

vety.v: Help! Mr. Frost [is melting|melts]! Turn on the air conditioning!
vety.pozn: Help! – děje se to **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Bees [make|are making] honey.
vety.pozn: Obecná pravda → present simple.

vety.v: Wait a minute, I [am talking|talk] on the phone.
vety.pozn: Počkej, **teď** telefonuju → present continuous.

vety.v: Doctor Fin is a dentist. He [works|is working] in the hotel clinic.
vety.pozn: Povolání, kde pracuje pořád → present simple.

vety.v: Don't disturb Sparkle, she [is doing|does] her homework.
vety.pozn: Neruš ji – dělá to **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: Turn off the TV, nobody [is watching|watches] it.
vety.pozn: Teď se nikdo nedívá → present continuous.

vety.v: Zork comes from Mars. He [speaks|is speaking] Martian.
vety.pozn: Jakým jazykem mluví – to platí pořád → present simple.

vety.v: Look at Smokey! Her nose [is smoking|smokes].
vety.pozn: Look at… → vidíš to teď → present continuous.

vety.v: Take an umbrella, it [is raining|rains].
vety.pozn: Prší **teď** → present continuous.

vety.v: It [rains|is raining] a lot in this town.
vety.pozn: A lot = často, obecně → present simple.

vety.v: Ducks [swim|are swimming] very well.
vety.pozn: Co kachny umí, platí pořád → present simple.

vety.v: Where are the twins? – They [are playing|play] in the garden.
vety.pozn: Kde jsou teď? → present continuous.

vety.v: The hotel [opens|is opening] at seven o'clock.
vety.pozn: Otevírací doba, jízdní řády a programy → present simple.

vety.v: What's that noise? Rex [is stomping|stomps] down the stairs.
vety.pozn: Co je to za hluk? → děje se to teď → present continuous.

lina.rada: Líná slovesa (**like, love, hate, want, need, know, understand, believe, remember, mean, own, belong, seem, hear**) -ing nechtějí – ani když je ve větě **now**.

vety.v: Garlicula [likes|is liking] tomato juice.
vety.pozn: Like = mít rád, je to líné sloveso → bez -ing.

vety.v: I [know|am knowing] the answer!
vety.pozn: Know = vědět, stav → nikdy -ing.

vety.v: Bolt [doesn't understand|isn't understanding] jokes.
vety.pozn: Understand = rozumět, líné sloveso → don't/doesn't, ne isn't + -ing.

vety.v: Zork [wants|is wanting] a pizza right now.
vety.pozn: I když je tam right now, want je líné sloveso → wants.

vety.v: Look! The Duchess [hates|is hating] the new carpet.
vety.pozn: I když je tam Look!, hate = nesnášet, líné sloveso → hates.

vety.v: We [need|are needing] more towels at the moment.
vety.pozn: Need = potřebovat, líné sloveso → need i s at the moment.

vety.v: Smokey [loves|is loving] spicy food.
vety.pozn: Love = milovat, stav → loves.

vety.v: This suitcase [belongs|is belonging] to Granny Rocket.
vety.pozn: Belong = patřit, líné sloveso.

vety.v: Boo [believes|is believing] in humans.
vety.pozn: Believe = věřit, líné sloveso.

vety.v: Polly [knows|is knowing] seven languages.
vety.pozn: Know → knows, nikdy knowing.

vety.v: Right now Inky [prefers|is preferring] tea to coffee.
vety.pozn: Prefer = mít raději, líné sloveso i s right now.

vety.v: Mr. Frost [doesn't like|isn't liking] the sun.
vety.pozn: Like je líné → zápor doesn't like.

vety.v: Bolt and Zork [want|are wanting] ice cream now.
vety.pozn: Want je líné sloveso → want i s now.

vety.v: I [understand|am understanding] you now.
vety.pozn: Understand je líné → understand i s now.

vety.v: Sparkle [hates|is hating] glitter.
vety.pozn: Hate = nesnášet → hates.

vety.v: Rex [owns|is owning] a tiny piano.
vety.pozn: Own = vlastnit, líné sloveso.

vety.v: Zelda [seems|is seeming] tired today.
vety.pozn: Seem = zdát se, líné sloveso i s today.

vety.v: Professor Hoot [knows|is knowing] everything.
vety.pozn: Know → knows.

vety.v: At the moment Speedy [needs|is needing] a long nap.
vety.pozn: Need je líné i s at the moment.

vety.v: Hazel [doesn't remember|isn't remembering] the spell.
vety.pozn: Remember = pamatovat si, líné sloveso → doesn't remember.

vety.v: We [love|are loving] this crazy hotel!
vety.pozn: Love je líné sloveso → love.

vety.v: What [does this word mean|is this word meaning]?
vety.pozn: Mean = znamenat, líné sloveso → otázka s does.

vety.v: Pierre [doesn't want|isn't wanting] to slip again.
vety.pozn: Want je líné → doesn't want.

vety.v: Croak [believes|is believing] that he is a prince.
vety.pozn: Believe je líné sloveso.

vety.v: Listen! I [hear|am hearing] a strange noise.
vety.pozn: Hear = slyšet (smyslem), líné sloveso i po Listen!

vety.v: Buzz [likes|is liking] sunflowers best.
vety.pozn: Like → likes.

vety.v: [Do you know|Are you knowing] Count Garlicula?
vety.pozn: Know je líné → otázka Do you know…?

dvoji.rada: **have** = mít/vlastnit → bez -ing; ale have lunch / a shower / fun = dělat něco → může -ing. **think** = názor → bez -ing; think about = přemýšlet → může -ing.

vety.v: Bolt [has|is having] two batteries.
vety.pozn: Have = mít (vlastnit) → bez -ing.

vety.v: Bolt [is having|has] a shower right now.
vety.pozn: Have a shower = sprchovat se, činnost → is having.

vety.v: Garlicula [is having|has] breakfast at the moment.
vety.pozn: Have breakfast = snídat, činnost teď → is having.

vety.v: Granny Rocket [has|is having] three skateboards.
vety.pozn: Vlastní je → has.

vety.v: Shh! The guests [are having|have] dinner.
vety.pozn: Večeří **teď** → are having.

vety.v: We [are having|have] a great time at the pool!
vety.pozn: Have a great time = užívat si, teď → are having.

vety.v: Polly [has|is having] green feathers.
vety.pozn: Má zelené peří (vlastnost) → has.

vety.v: I [think|am thinking] this hotel is crazy.
vety.pozn: Think = myslet si (názor) → bez -ing.

vety.v: Be quiet, Professor Hoot [is thinking|thinks] about a difficult question.
vety.pozn: Think about = přemýšlet, teď → is thinking.

vety.v: Zork [thinks|is thinking] that socks are hats.
vety.pozn: Myslí si to (názor) → thinks.

vety.v: Inky [is tasting|tastes] the soup now.
vety.pozn: Ochutnává (činnost) → is tasting.

vety.v: This soup [tastes|is tasting] of old socks.
vety.pozn: Taste = chutnat (jak chutná) → stav, bez -ing.

vety.v: Look! Zelda [is smelling|smells] the roses.
vety.pozn: Čichá k růžím (činnost) → is smelling.

vety.v: Mmm, the cake [smells|is smelling] wonderful!
vety.pozn: Smell = vonět → stav, bez -ing.

vety.v: Don't wake him! Speedy [is having|has] a nap.
vety.pozn: Have a nap = dát si šlofíka, teď → is having.

vety.v: Doctor Fin [has|is having] very big teeth.
vety.pozn: Má velké zuby (vlastnost) → has.

docasne.rada: Napořád, trvale → **present simple**. Jen na chvíli, dočasně (this week, these days, at the moment) → **present continuous**.

vety.v: Bolt usually works in the kitchen, but this week he [is working|works] at reception.
vety.pozn: This week = jen dočasně → is working.

vety.v: Granny Rocket [lives|is living] in Prague.
vety.pozn: Bydlí tam napořád → lives.

vety.v: This week Granny Rocket [is staying|stays] at Hotel Kuriózum.
vety.pozn: V hotelu je jen dočasně → is staying.

vety.v: Zork [is learning|learns] English this year.
vety.pozn: This year = dočasné období → is learning.

vety.v: Garlicula [is reading|reads] a very long book these days.
vety.pozn: These days = v poslední době, dočasně → is reading.

vety.v: Normally Mr. Frost [lives|is living] in the Arctic.
vety.pozn: Normally = obvykle, trvale → lives.

vety.v: This month the Duchess [is sleeping|sleeps] in a shoebox.
vety.pozn: This month = dočasně → is sleeping.

vety.v: Inky [cooks|is cooking] in this hotel every summer.
vety.pozn: Every summer = pravidelně → cooks.

vety.v: Speedy [is getting|gets] faster and faster.
vety.pozn: Něco se právě mění (pořád rychlejší) → is getting.

vety.v: Doctor Fin [works|is working] as a dentist. That's his job.
vety.pozn: Povolání = trvale → works.

vety.v: Today Polly [is wearing|wears] a tiny hat.
vety.pozn: Dnes výjimečně → is wearing.

vety.v: Hazel [usually flies|is usually flying] on a broom.
vety.pozn: Usually = obvykle → flies.

vety.v: At the moment Smokey [is working|works] as a lifeguard.
vety.pozn: At the moment = dočasně → is working.

vety.v: Sparkle [runs|is running] a marathon every year.
vety.pozn: Every year = pravidelně → runs.
